settings.title: Shipping
settings.heading: Shipping
settings.body:
August aims to ship all orders out within two business days of order placement.

August uses USPS to ship both domestic and international orders. Free in-store pickup at 414 State St, Madison.

settings.title: Returns
settings.heading: Returns
settings.body:
Returns will be accepted only for store credit within 14 days of receipt. If 14 days have gone by since your purchase, unfortunately, we can’t offer you a credit or exchange.

Special and limited releases are final sale – no returns.

Items bought on sale are final sale.

settings.note: Free local pickup in Madison  ·  Sale items are final sale
